author: Casey Cruise
releaseNotes: Initial release v1.0.0. Proven live on the Game Room hub (C-8, platform 2.5.2.139, Hub Login Security enabled) Oct 30, 2026: backupNow fetched the day's scheduled backup (3,183,312 bytes) and pushed it to the Util2 receiver, which stored it byte-for-byte (SHA-256 recorded by the driver). Design: on-hub push - the driver logs in to the hub's Diagnostic Tool API with the hub MAC (no platform credentials stored or used), downloads the newest backup into memory only, and POSTs it to a token-gated receiver that writes to plumnas home_lab_backups/hubitat. Commands: backupNow (the nightly motion) and createAndPushBackup (60-second create timeout with a list/download fallback). Trigger via a dedicated Maker API instance, Rule Machine, or the optional built-in nightly schedule (default off; scheduled failures retry once after 15 minutes). Unproven: the Living Room hub (rollout follows from this repo) and the built-in schedule route.
